query:
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                      'username', u.username, 'created_at', b.created_at)
                  ORDER BY b.created_at, u.username), '[]') AS "rows!"
           FROM user_blocks b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.blocked_user_id
           WHERE b.user_id = $1
